The '''Salvage Guild''' or '''Salvagers' Guild''' was one of the many [[Wroonian Guilds]]. In the wake of the destruction of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vengeance (Golthan)|''Vengeance'']], the Salvage Guild offered 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] recovered in good condition.
